# 03 — Prototype link · Hygisense

**Working prototype (S4): the pharmacist's app** — `prototype/app.html` (double-click; no server). Generated by `run_eval.py` from the real pipeline (real drugs, ANSM declarations, FDA shortages, Sentinelles epidemics; simulated pharmacy "Pharmacie des Lilas").

| Screen | What the pharmacist does |
|---|---|
| **Commande** | Reads the order prepared overnight (read-only by default) → *Modifier la commande*: edit quantities (warning above the anti-hoarding cap), switch supplier (★ preferred generic lab), remove lines, add any product incl. parapharmacy → *Envoyer au logiciel* (file for the LGO, sent by PharmaML from there) |
| **Vigilance** | Risk ×N of every product for the next 8 weeks, with reasons (MITM, single lab, US shortage…); epidemic curves with the 4-week forecast; filters |
| **Rapports** | Weekly / monthly report: turnover, estimated margin, boxes sold, boxes missed, shortages anticipated; preview of the automatic e-mail |
| **Paramètres** | E-mail and report schedule, sync times, read-only by default, cover and cap, epidemic adjustment, wholesaler, preferred generic lab and discount, vigilance threshold |
| **Méthode** | The evaluation numbers and the 20 guardrail cases (for the jury) |

Direct links: `app.html#vigilance`, `#rapports`, `#parametres`, `#methode`, `#edition`.

**First clickable mock-up (S3):** `prototype/hygisense_prototype.html` (simulated data), also published at https://claude.ai/artifact/WgBRoNJX8kFztdCaHnR814

## Test task (for the pilot, 20 minutes, think aloud, don't help)

"It is 8:30, you open the pharmacy. Using this screen, decide what you will buy ahead today, and tell us one recommendation you would refuse and why."

No user has tried it yet (see 03_user_research.md).
